facts.fact: The decree D/2025/052 of 14 April 2025 cites Law L/2020/027/AN of 19 December 2020 on the right of access to public information among the laws it rests on.
facts.system: Loi L/2020/027/AN portant Droit d'Accès à l'Information Publique

GIN.note: The decree records residence addresses in persons' files but states no addressing system or address register.
The decree says the register serves identification and authentication but states no authentication service.

facts.fact: Decree D/2025/052 provides that the national register of persons is run by the body in charge of both civil status and identification, and is fed by the national civil status register.
facts.system: Registre National des Personnes Physiques (RNPP) / Registre National de l'État Civil (RNEC)

systems.owner: body in charge of civil status and identification
systems.tiers: communal and consular registers under a national register

GIN.note: The document says nothing about a business register.
The decree names the civil status register but states no digital civil registration system.
The document says nothing about digital-skills training for civil servants.

facts.fact: Law L/2023/019/CNT of 25 October 2023 on the identification of natural persons is the law under which decree D/2025/052 is made, and the decree sets up a register of biometric and biographic data with a personal identification number.
facts.system: Loi L/2023/019/CNT portant Identification des Personnes Physiques

facts.fact: Decree D/2025/052/PRG/CNRD/SGG, signed 14 April 2025 and effective on signature, fixes the rules for entering persons in and keeping the national register of natural persons, in application of Law L/2023/019/CNT.

GIN.note: The document says nothing about a voters' roll.
The decree gives no count or share of people enrolled.
The decree does not state that a number is given at birth registration.
The document says nothing about who operates, maintains or owns the ID system platform.
The decree requires the personal number for any service but names no public register keyed on it.

facts.fact: Decree D/2025/052 of 14 April 2025 defines the national register of natural persons as a database of biographic and biometric (fingerprint, photograph) data for identification, without stating that it is issuing numbers.

systems.owner: body in charge of civil status and identification
systems.tiers: communal and consular registers under a national register

GIN.note: The document says nothing about a land register.
The decree has communes keep resident registers but states no connection of local government offices.
The document says nothing about police station records.

facts.fact: Decree D/2025/052 of 14 April 2025 sets up the national register of natural persons, made of communal and consular resident registers, and says it is kept up to date by the civil status register, with deaths entered in it at once.

systems.owner: body in charge of civil status and identification
systems.tiers: communal and consular registers under a national register

GIN.note: The decree does not state that civil registration offices enter births or deaths digitally.
The document says nothing about a social registry.
The document says nothing about a taxpayer register.
